figures.ask_en: What do these three LEA14 salinity panels actually show?
figures.ask_zh: 這三張 LEA14 鹽逆境圖實際上顯示了什麼？
figures.a_en: Three readouts from the salinity set at 0, 75 and 100 mM NaCl, for untreated, pre-treatment and post-treatment LEA14 supernatant. Panel (a), fresh weight, carries one point per bar: untreated at 0 mM is highest at about 0.84 g and every other group sits between 0.54 and 0.61 g. Panel (b) divides chlorophyll by that single weight, panel (c) does not. Post-treatment has no 0 mM group, and the only significance bracket runs from untreated 0 mM to untreated 75 mM.
figures.a_zh: 這是鹽逆境組在 0、75、100 mM NaCl 下的三項讀數，比較未處理、前處理與後處理 LEA14 上清液。(a) 鮮重每根柱只有一個點：未處理 0 mM 最高，約 0.84 g，其餘各組都落在 0.54 到 0.61 g。(b) 是葉綠素除以那個單一鮮重，(c) 則未除。後處理沒有 0 mM 組，而唯一的顯著性括號是從未處理 0 mM 連到未處理 75 mM。
figures.q_en: In panel (b) post-treatment LEA14 at 75 mM NaCl is the tallest bar, near 1.8. What most limits that bar?
figures.q_zh: 在 (b) 圖中，後處理 LEA14 於 75 mM NaCl 是最高的一根，約 1.8。這根柱最大的限制是什麼？
opt_en: It is chlorophyll divided by fresh weight, and fresh weight is a single pooled measurement per group, so a small denominator lifts the ratio.
It is the only bar without replicate points, so it carries no error bar.
It was measured at 100 mM NaCl rather than 75 mM, so the label is wrong.
It is significantly different from its own salt-stressed control, as the bracket shows.
opt_zh: 它是葉綠素除以鮮重，而鮮重每組只有一個合併測值，分母一小、比值就被抬高。
它是唯一沒有重複點的柱，所以沒有誤差棒。
它其實量的是 100 mM NaCl 而非 75 mM，標籤標錯了。
如括號所示，它和自己的鹽逆境對照組有顯著差異。
figures.trap_en: Reading panel (b) as protection: the same group falls to about 0.85 in panel (c), where chlorophyll is not divided by fresh weight.
figures.trap_zh: 把 (b) 圖當成保護效果：同一組在未除鮮重的 (c) 圖只剩約 0.85。

figures.ask_en: Take me through this BoPep4 folding figure.
figures.ask_zh: 帶我看一下這張 BoPep4 摺疊圖。
figures.a_en: A 236 nt translation-initiation window folded in ViennaRNA 2.7.2 at 37 °C. The table ranks the ordered design fourth of 42,581 variants: start+15 accessibility 0.396 to 0.497, Shine-Dalgarno core 0.067 to 0.634, nine codons changed, 11 bases recoded, CAI 0.87 down to 0.77. Panels (b) and (c) are the predicted minimum-free-energy structures and (d) the per-base unpaired probability. All of it is folding prediction. Translation initiation from this cassette has never been measured.
figures.a_zh: 這是 236 nt 的轉譯起始視窗，用 ViennaRNA 2.7.2 在 37 °C 下摺疊。表格顯示訂購的設計在 42,581 個變體中排第 4：start+15 可及性由 0.396 升到 0.497，Shine-Dalgarno 核心由 0.067 升到 0.634，改了 9 個密碼子、11 個鹼基，CAI 由 0.87 降到 0.77。(b)(c) 是預測的最低自由能結構，(d) 是每個鹼基的未配對機率。全部都是摺疊預測，這個卡匣的轉譯起始從未被量測過。
figures.q_en: The ordered variant has a lower MFE (-49.1) than the wild type (-43.2). Why is that not a contradiction?
figures.q_zh: 訂購的變體 MFE（-49.1）比野生型（-43.2）更低，為什麼這不矛盾？
opt_en: The score is local accessibility at the ribosome binding site and start codon, not whole-window stability; the window can fold tighter elsewhere while opening at initiation.
Lower MFE always means better initiation, so the two numbers agree.
MFE and accessibility are in different units, so the two can never be compared at all.
The ordered variant is shorter than the wild type, so its MFE is not comparable.
opt_zh: 評分看的是核醣體結合位與起始密碼子的局部可及性，不是整段視窗的穩定度；視窗其他地方可以摺得更緊，起始區仍然打開。
MFE 越低就代表起始越好，所以兩個數字本來就一致。
MFE 和可及性單位不同，兩者根本無法比較。
訂購的變體比野生型短，所以 MFE 不能相比。
figures.trap_en: Treating the accessibility gain as measured expression; it is a ViennaRNA number and no translation from this cassette has been measured.
figures.trap_zh: 把可及性的提升當成量到的表現量；那只是 ViennaRNA 的數字，這個卡匣的轉譯從未量測。

figures.ask_en: What does this Asn23-Arg487 panel tell you about the His tag?
figures.ask_zh: 這張 Asn23–Arg487 圖告訴你 His 標籤的什麼事？
figures.a_en: Three panels on the one contact the design rests on. In (a) Arg487 grips the Asn23 C-terminal carboxylate with both oxygens in 100.0 % of wild-type frames and 99.5 % of AtPep1 frames; with a C-terminal 6xHis tag bidentate engagement is 0.0 % and monodentate 99.3 %. In (b) the first shell is the peptide C-terminal COO- for both controls and a backbone carbonyl for the tagged system. In (c) the charge centres sit 4.0 Å apart for the controls and 20.1 Å with the tag.
figures.a_zh: 三張圖都在講設計所倚靠的那一個接觸。(a) Arg487 以兩個氧抓住 Asn23 的 C 端羧基，野生型 100.0 % 的 frames、AtPep1 99.5 %；加上 C 端 6xHis 標籤後，雙齒結合變成 0.0 %，單齒 99.3 %。(b) 第一殼層在兩組對照是胜肽 C 端 COO−，在加標籤的系統則換成主鏈羰基。(c) 電荷中心距離在對照是 4.0 Å，加標籤後是 20.1 Å。
figures.q_en: Every BoPep4 part the team deposited carries a C-terminal His tag. What does panel (c) imply for them?
figures.q_zh: 團隊上傳的每一個 BoPep4 part 都帶 C 端 His 標籤。(c) 圖對它們意味著什麼？
opt_en: The charge pair the model says holds the peptide is 20.1 Å apart in the tagged system, so the deposited constructs lack the contact the design rests on.
Nothing, because SamyQ cleavage removes the C-terminal tag during secretion.
The tag pulls the charge pair closer, so binding is predicted to improve.
Nothing, because panel (c) only concerns AtPep1 and not BoPep4.
opt_zh: 模型認為抓住胜肽的那對電荷，在加標籤的系統相距 20.1 Å，所以上傳的構築缺少設計所倚靠的那個接觸。
沒有影響，因為分泌時 SamyQ 的切割會把 C 端標籤移除。
標籤把電荷對拉得更近，所以預測結合會變好。
沒有影響，因為 (c) 圖只牽涉 AtPep1，與 BoPep4 無關。
figures.trap_en: Reading the red bar at 99.3 % in panel (a) as healthy engagement; it is monodentate, a backbone carbonyl standing in for the free carboxylate.
figures.trap_zh: 把 (a) 圖紅柱的 99.3 % 讀成結合良好；那是單齒，由主鏈羰基頂替了自由羧基。

figures.ask_en: Point at the green plants on this rack. What can you conclude?
figures.ask_zh: 指著這盤架上還綠的植株，你能下什麼結論？
figures.a_en: The hydroponic rack after four days at 37 °C. Most rosettes have bleached to white or pale yellow. Green is retained across the ACC deaminase row at all four dilutions, and also in the 1/40 WB800 vehicle bracketed in the same block; the 0.1x MS medium control in that block is bleached. It is one photograph of one rack, three seedlings per bracketed group, no repeat and no quantification on the panel itself.
figures.a_zh: 這是在 37 °C 放四天之後的水耕盤架。多數蓮座葉已經白化或變成淡黃。ACC deaminase 那一列四個稀釋度都還留著綠色，同一區塊裡被括起來的 1/40 WB800 載體對照也是綠的；同區塊的 0.1x MS 培養基對照則已白化。這只是一盤、一張照片，每個括號組三株，沒有重複，也沒有任何量化。
figures.q_en: The 1/40 WB800 vehicle beside the ACC deaminase row is also green. What does that do to the claim?
figures.q_zh: ACC deaminase 列旁邊的 1/40 WB800 載體對照也是綠的。這對結論有什麼影響？
opt_en: It weakens it: a control with no protectant survived as well, so greenness in that block cannot be attributed to the cargo.
Nothing, because the WB800 vehicle is known to be inert.
It strengthens it, because the vehicle carries the same ACC deaminase cassette.
It means the ACC deaminase dose was too low to matter at any dilution.
opt_zh: 會削弱結論：一個不含保護蛋白的對照也活得一樣好，所以那一區塊的綠色不能歸功於貨物蛋白。
沒有影響，因為已知 WB800 載體本身是惰性的。
會強化結論，因為載體帶有相同的 ACC deaminase 卡匣。
代表任何稀釋度下 ACC deaminase 劑量都低到沒有作用。
figures.trap_en: Scoring green against bleached across the rack by eye and calling it an effect of the supernatant, when the matching vehicle control in the same block is green too.
figures.trap_zh: 用肉眼比對整盤的綠與白化就當成上清液的效果，但同區塊相對應的載體對照同樣是綠的。

figures.ask_en: What is this pre-stress rack photograph good for?
figures.ask_zh: 這張逆境前的盤架照片能用來做什麼？
figures.a_en: The same hydroponic rack photographed before the heat stress, with 15-day-old Arabidopsis. Every plug is green and the rosettes look comparable. The rack carries ACC deaminase at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100, BoPep4 at the same four dilutions, and a 1/40 WB800 vehicle plus a 0.1x MS medium control repeated for each arm, three seedlings per bracket. White fuzz is visible on at least two plugs. This image carries no measurement.
figures.a_zh: 這是同一組水耕盤架在熱逆境之前拍的，裡面是 15 天大的阿拉伯芥。每個孔的植株都是綠的，蓮座葉看起來彼此相當。盤上有 ACC deaminase 的 1/40、1/60、1/80、1/100，BoPep4 同樣四個稀釋度，以及每一臂各自重複的 1/40 WB800 載體與 0.1x MS 培養基對照，每括號三株。至少兩個孔上看得到白色菌絲。這張照片本身沒有任何測量值。
figures.q_en: What is the legitimate use of this photograph in the argument?
figures.q_zh: 在論證裡，這張照片的正當用途是什麼？
opt_en: Showing the rack started uniform and healthy, so later bleaching is not a pre-existing difference between groups.
Showing that ACC deaminase supernatant already improved growth before the heat stress began.
Scoring chlorophyll, since leaf colour in this image is quantitative.
Establishing the replicate number, which the photograph sets at nine seedlings per group.
opt_zh: 顯示盤架一開始是整齊而健康的，所以後來的白化不是各組原本就有的差異。
顯示在熱逆境開始前，ACC deaminase 上清液就已經促進了生長。
用來評分葉綠素，因為這張影像的葉色是可量化的。
用來確立重複數，照片顯示每組有九株。
figures.trap_en: Reading small size differences in the baseline photograph as a dose response; nothing was measured at this point.
figures.trap_zh: 把基線照片裡細微的大小差異讀成劑量反應；這個時間點什麼都還沒量。

figures.ask_en: Walk me through the four trajectory panels.
figures.ask_zh: 帶我看一下這四張軌跡圖。
figures.a_en: Eight peptide-bound systems plus apo PEPR1, 30 ns each, 1,500 frames, smoothed over 500 ps. Panel (a) is receptor Ca RMSD against a 3.0 A gate, (b) peptide backbone RMSD in the receptor frame against 4.0 A, (c) the minimum heavy-atom distance across Asn23-Arg487 with the 4 A cut-off and the 5GR8 crystal value at 2.4 A, and (d) clamp contacts against a floor of 3 of 4. Only the two 9-23 systems leave the band for long.
figures.a_zh: 八個結合胜肽的系統加上單獨的 PEPR1，各跑 30 ns、1,500 frames，用 500 ps 滾動平均平滑。(a) 是受體 Cα RMSD 對 3.0 Å 的門檻，(b) 是在受體座標下的胜肽主鏈 RMSD 對 4.0 Å，(c) 是 Asn23–Arg487 的最短重原子距離，標了 4 Å 判定線與 5GR8 晶體的 2.4 Å，(d) 是夾持接觸數對 4 取 3 的底線。只有兩個 9–23 系統長時間離開區間。
figures.q_en: The red trace, wild type plus C-terminal His6, hugs the wild type in panel (c). Why is that misleading?
figures.q_zh: 紅色曲線（野生型加 C 端 His6）在 (c) 圖幾乎貼著野生型。為什麼這會誤導人？
opt_en: Panel (c) is a minimum heavy-atom distance, which a backbone carbonyl can satisfy; in that system the bidentate carboxylate contact is 0.0 % of frames.
The red trace is in fact above the 4 A line for most of the run.
The tagged system was only run for 10 ns, so the rest of its trace is padding.
The minimum distance in the tagged system is measured to a different arginine.
opt_zh: (c) 圖量的是最短重原子距離，主鏈羰基就能滿足；而在那個系統裡，雙齒羧基接觸是 0.0 % 的 frames。
紅色曲線其實大半段都在 4 Å 線之上。
加標籤的系統只跑了 10 ns，後面的曲線是補上去的。
加標籤系統的最短距離是量到另一個精胺酸。
figures.trap_en: Taking a trace that stays inside the gates as evidence of binding; the tagged and truncated systems stay inside while losing the contact the design rests on.
figures.trap_zh: 把留在門檻內的曲線當成結合的證據；加標籤與截短的系統都待在門檻內，卻失去了設計所倚靠的接觸。

figures.ask_en: Which of these bars should worry you most?
figures.ask_zh: 這些長條裡，哪一根最該讓你擔心？
figures.a_en: Fraction of the 1,500 production frames in which each contact is made, for eight systems. Dashed red lines mark the 60 % pass mark on Arg487 within 4 A and on clamp at 3 of 4 or better, written down before the runs. Only BoPep4 9-23 at pH 5.5 fails, at 23.6 % and 19.3 %. BoPep4 WT plus C-His6 reads 99.8, 100.0, 99.7 and 100.0, and 15-23, the pre-registered negative control, reads 99.9, 97.1, 99.9 and 100.0.
figures.a_zh: 這是八個系統在 1,500 個生產 frames 中各接觸出現的比例。紅色虛線標出事前寫下的 60 % 通過線，分別落在 Arg487 ≤4 Å 與夾持 ≥3/4 兩欄。只有 BoPep4 9–23 在 pH 5.5 不通過，為 23.6 % 與 19.3 %。BoPep4 WT 加 C-His6 是 99.8、100.0、99.7、100.0；事前登記為陰性對照的 15–23 則是 99.9、97.1、99.9、100.0。
figures.q_en: Which system here is the clearest sign the criteria are not measuring binding?
figures.q_zh: 圖上哪一個系統最清楚顯示這些標準量的不是結合？
opt_en: BoPep4 WT plus C-His6, which passes all four although the His tag removes the free C-terminal carboxylate entirely.
BoPep4 9-23 at pH 5.5, which fails two of the four.
AtPep1 7-23, the literature control, which scores 100 %.
BoPep4 7-23, whose Asn465 occupancy is only 62.9 %.
opt_zh: BoPep4 WT 加 C-His6：His 標籤把自由 C 端羧基完全拿掉，它卻四項全過。
BoPep4 9–23 於 pH 5.5，它四項中有兩項不過。
文獻對照 AtPep1 7–23，它拿到 100 %。
BoPep4 7–23，它的 Asn465 佔有率只有 62.9 %。
figures.trap_en: Reading a bar near 100 % as a strong interface; occupancy counts a distance being satisfied, not which chemical group satisfies it.
figures.trap_zh: 把接近 100 % 的長條當成界面很強；佔有率只算距離有沒有被滿足，不管是哪個化學基團滿足它。

figures.ask_en: Does the BoPep4 salinity run show a protective effect?
figures.ask_zh: 這組 BoPep4 鹽逆境試驗有顯示保護效果嗎？
figures.a_en: Three panels from the BoPep4 salinity run, twelve groups each, one bar per group, three seedlings, no error bars and no repeat. On fresh weight the best salt-stressed group is 1/40 BoPep4 at about 0.049 g, against 0.043 g for the 1/40 WB800 vehicle and 0.028 g for 0.1x MS medium. On chlorophyll per plant 1/40 BoPep4 reaches about 8.4 ug against 2.1 and 4.4. The third panel reverses the order.
figures.a_zh: 這是 BoPep4 鹽逆境試驗的三張圖，每張 12 組，每組一根柱、三株苗，沒有誤差棒也沒有重複。鮮重上，鹽逆境中最高的是 1/40 BoPep4 約 0.049 g，1/40 WB800 載體約 0.043 g，0.1x MS 培養基約 0.028 g。每株葉綠素上，1/40 BoPep4 約 8.4 µg，對照分別是 2.1 與 4.4。第三張圖則把順序倒過來。
figures.q_en: Panels one and two favour 1/40 BoPep4. What does the third panel do?
figures.q_zh: 前兩張圖都偏向 1/40 BoPep4，第三張圖呢？
opt_en: It reverses the ranking: 0.1x MS medium is the highest salt-stressed group at about 0.99, above 1/40 BoPep4 at about 0.81.
It repeats the same ranking on a smaller scale, with 1/40 BoPep4 still on top.
It shows 1/40 BoPep4 highest again, this time with error bars added.
It drops the medium control, so no comparison can be made there.
opt_zh: 它把順序倒過來：0.1x MS 培養基是鹽逆境組中最高的，約 0.99，高於 1/40 BoPep4 的約 0.81。
它以較小的尺度重複同樣的排序，1/40 BoPep4 仍然最高。
它再次顯示 1/40 BoPep4 最高，而且這次加了誤差棒。
它把培養基對照拿掉了，所以沒辦法比較。
figures.trap_en: Quoting the chlorophyll panel alone; the relative chlorophyll panel on the same figure puts the untreated medium control on top.
figures.trap_zh: 只引用葉綠素那一張；同一張圖的相對葉綠素把未處理的培養基對照放在最上面。

figures.ask_en: Read me the heated groups in this BoPep4 heat figure.
figures.ask_zh: 把這張 BoPep4 熱逆境圖的加熱組念給我聽。
figures.a_en: Three panels, twelve groups, one bar per group. Heat flattens everything: fresh weight falls from about 0.09 g unheated to between 0.011 and 0.030 g heated. Among the heated groups the 1/40 WB800 vehicle is the heaviest at about 0.030 g, above every BoPep4 dilution. On chlorophyll per plant 1/40 BoPep4 leads at about 2.2 ug against 0.6 for the vehicle, and on relative chlorophyll it leads at about 0.81 against 0.26. The two readouts disagree.
figures.a_zh: 三張圖、12 組，每組一根柱。熱逆境把一切壓平：鮮重從未加熱的約 0.09 g 掉到加熱後的 0.011 至 0.030 g。加熱組裡最重的是 1/40 WB800 載體，約 0.030 g，高於每一個 BoPep4 稀釋度。每株葉綠素上，1/40 BoPep4 約 2.2 µg，載體約 0.6；相對葉綠素上，1/40 BoPep4 約 0.81，載體約 0.26。兩種讀數彼此不一致。
figures.q_en: On fresh weight, which heated group is the heaviest?
figures.q_zh: 就鮮重而言，加熱組裡哪一組最重？
opt_en: The 1/40 WB800 vehicle, at about 0.030 g, above every BoPep4 dilution.
1/40 BoPep4, at about 0.030 g, just above the vehicle.
0.1x MS medium, at about 0.055 g.
1/100 BoPep4, which recovers to roughly the unheated level.
opt_zh: 1/40 WB800 載體，約 0.030 g，高於每一個 BoPep4 稀釋度。
1/40 BoPep4，約 0.030 g，剛好高過載體。
0.1x MS 培養基，約 0.055 g。
1/100 BoPep4，它回復到大約未加熱的水準。
figures.trap_en: Showing only the chlorophyll panels; on fresh weight the vehicle control sits above every treated group.
figures.trap_zh: 只秀葉綠素那兩張；在鮮重上，載體對照高於每一個處理組。

figures.ask_en: What does this AcdS folding figure claim, and what does it not?
figures.ask_zh: 這張 AcdS 摺疊圖主張了什麼，又沒有主張什麼？
figures.a_en: A 236 nt initiation window folded in ViennaRNA 2.7.2 at 37 °C. The table ranks the ordered design third of 49,987: start+15 accessibility 0.563 to 0.773, Shine-Dalgarno core 0.088 to 0.203, twelve synonymous codon changes, 15 bases recoded, CAI 0.85 to 0.75. Panels (b) and (c) are predicted structures and (d) the per-base unpaired probability. Two limits: initiation has never been measured, and the deposited fusion keeps the 93 bp SamyQ segment identical to wild type.
figures.a_zh: 這是 236 nt 的起始視窗，用 ViennaRNA 2.7.2 在 37 °C 下摺疊。表格顯示訂購的設計在 49,987 個變體中排第 3：start+15 可及性 0.563 升到 0.773，Shine-Dalgarno 核心 0.088 升到 0.203，12 個同義密碼子變更、15 個鹼基改寫，CAI 由 0.85 降到 0.75。(b)(c) 是預測結構，(d) 是每鹼基未配對機率。兩個限制：起始從未被量測；而上傳的融合序列中，93 bp 的 SamyQ 區段與野生型完全相同。
figures.q_en: The folded window includes the SamyQ signal peptide. Why does that matter for the deposited part?
figures.q_zh: 摺疊的視窗包含 SamyQ 訊號胜肽，這對上傳的 part 有什麼影響？
opt_en: The starred candidate recodes bases inside SamyQ, but the deposited fusions keep that 93 bp segment identical to wild type, so figure and deposit come from different runs.
It does not matter, because SamyQ is cleaved off the mature protein anyway.
It means the signal peptide was redesigned in the deposited sequence as well.
It means the 236 nt window is too short to reach the start codon.
opt_zh: 被標記的候選在 SamyQ 內部改寫了鹼基，但上傳的融合序列把那 93 bp 區段保持與野生型相同，所以圖和上傳的序列來自不同次執行。
沒有影響，因為 SamyQ 本來就會從成熟蛋白上被切掉。
代表上傳的序列裡訊號胜肽也一併重新設計過。
代表 236 nt 的視窗太短，根本涵蓋不到起始密碼子。
figures.trap_en: Assuming the sequence drawn in this panel is the sequence you would order; for AcdS the deposit keeps SamyQ wild type.
figures.trap_zh: 以為圖上畫的序列就是你會訂到的序列；AcdS 的上傳版本把 SamyQ 保留為野生型。

figures.ask_en: Explain this predicted-versus-measured table.
figures.ask_zh: 解釋一下這張「預測對上量測」的表。
figures.a_en: Four rows setting the pre-registered acceptance criteria against what the run gave. All four were predicted to fail. All four passed: receptor Ca RMSD 2.10 A against a 3.0 A gate, peptide backbone RMSD 1.83 A against 4.0 A, Asn23-Arg487 within 4 A for 99.9 % of frames, and clamp at 3 of 4 or better for 100.0 %. The note under the table says the criteria cannot tell this fragment from the wild type.
figures.a_zh: 四列把事前登記的驗收標準和實際跑出來的結果並排。四項都被預測為不通過，結果四項全過：受體 Cα RMSD 2.10 Å（門檻 3.0 Å）、胜肽主鏈 RMSD 1.83 Å（門檻 4.0 Å）、Asn23–Arg487 在 4 Å 內佔 99.9 % 的 frames、夾持 ≥3/4 佔 100.0 %。表下的註記直說：這些標準分辨不出這個片段和野生型。
figures.q_en: 15-23 was built as a negative control and passed every criterion. What did the team do about it?
figures.q_zh: 15–23 是當陰性對照做的，卻每一項都通過。團隊怎麼處理？
opt_en: Published it and concluded the criteria were measuring something other than binding.
Loosened the gates until 15-23 failed, then reported the revised criteria.
Dropped 15-23 from the panel as a failed simulation.
Reclassified 15-23 as a positive control and claimed a second active peptide.
opt_zh: 照樣發表，並下結論說這些標準量到的不是結合。
把門檻放寬到 15–23 不通過為止，再報告修改後的標準。
把 15–23 當成失敗的模擬，從面板中拿掉。
把 15–23 改歸類為陽性對照，宣稱找到第二個有活性的胜肽。
figures.trap_en: Reading four passes as four successes; failure was the prediction, so a pass here is a failure of the test, not of the peptide.
figures.trap_zh: 把四項通過讀成四項成功；原本預測的就是不通過，所以這裡的通過是測試失敗，不是胜肽失敗。

figures.ask_en: What changed between the wild type and the ordered LEA14 cassette?
figures.ask_zh: 野生型和訂購的 LEA14 卡匣之間改了什麼？
figures.a_en: A 236 nt initiation window folded in ViennaRNA 2.7.2 at 37 °C, wild type against the ordered recoding, ranked first of 43,944. Start+15 accessibility rises from 0.538 to 0.669 and the balance score from 0.895 to 0.976, but Shine-Dalgarno core accessibility falls slightly, 0.357 to 0.307, and CAI drops from 0.85 to 0.81. Six codons changed, nine bases recoded. All predicted; initiation has not been measured, and the deposit keeps SamyQ wild type.
figures.a_zh: 236 nt 的起始視窗，用 ViennaRNA 2.7.2 在 37 °C 摺疊，野生型對上訂購的改寫版，在 43,944 個變體中排第 1。start+15 可及性由 0.538 升到 0.669，平衡分數由 0.895 升到 0.976，但 Shine-Dalgarno 核心可及性略降，從 0.357 到 0.307，CAI 由 0.85 降到 0.81。改了 6 個密碼子、9 個鹼基。全是預測；起始未經量測，且上傳版本的 SamyQ 保留野生型。
figures.q_en: This variant ranks first of 43,944 but its Shine-Dalgarno accessibility goes down. How is that possible?
figures.q_zh: 這個變體在 43,944 個中排第 1，Shine-Dalgarno 可及性卻下降了，怎麼可能？
opt_en: The ranking uses a balance score combining start-codon and Shine-Dalgarno accessibility, so a large start+15 gain outweighs a small Shine-Dalgarno loss.
The ranking uses minimum free energy alone, so accessibility does not enter it.
The Shine-Dalgarno value is a typo; the structure panels show it rising.
Rank 1 refers to the codon adaptation index, which improved.
opt_zh: 排名用的是把起始密碼子與 Shine-Dalgarno 可及性合併的平衡分數，所以 start+15 的大幅提升蓋過 Shine-Dalgarno 的小幅下降。
排名只看最低自由能，可及性根本不計入。
Shine-Dalgarno 那個數字是打錯了，結構圖顯示它是上升的。
第 1 名指的是密碼子適應指數，而那項有改善。
figures.trap_en: Reporting rank 1 of 43,944 as a measured improvement; it is a position inside a folding-model search, not an expression result.
figures.trap_zh: 把「43,944 中第 1」講成量到的改善；那只是摺疊模型搜尋裡的名次，不是表現量結果。

figures.ask_en: What do the significance brackets in panel (b) compare?
figures.ask_zh: (b) 圖裡的顯著性括號在比較什麼？
figures.a_en: Four readouts from the agar thermo-priming set on day 15, one plate per condition. In (a) fresh weight, the unheated untreated plate is 0.065 g while pre-, co- and post-treatment reach about 0.455, 0.23 and 0.665 g; all heated groups sit near 0.02 to 0.04 g. Panel (b) divides chlorophyll by that weight and sets the unheated untreated plate as the 1.0 reference. Panel (c) is unnormalised. In (d) the co-treatment box collapses to a line near 20 mm.
figures.a_zh: 這是洋菜熱馴化組第 15 天的四項讀數，每個條件只有一盤。(a) 鮮重：未加熱未處理為 0.065 g，前、同、後處理分別約 0.455、0.23、0.665 g；加熱各組都在 0.02 到 0.04 g 之間。(b) 把葉綠素除以那個鮮重，並以未加熱未處理盤當作 1.0 的基準。(c) 則未標準化。(d) 中同處理那一格塌成一條約 20 mm 的線。
figures.q_en: In panel (b), what do the four **** brackets actually compare?
figures.q_zh: (b) 圖的四個 **** 括號實際上在比較什麼？
opt_en: The unstressed untreated control against the other groups; no bracket compares a treated group with its own heat-stressed control.
Each treatment against its own heat-stressed control, which is the comparison that matters.
Pre-treatment against post-treatment within the heat-stressed block.
The normalised and unnormalised chlorophyll panels against each other.
opt_zh: 是未逆境、未處理的對照對上其他各組；沒有任何括號把處理組和它自己的熱逆境對照相比。
是每個處理對上它自己的熱逆境對照，也就是真正重要的那個比較。
是熱逆境區塊內前處理對上後處理。
是標準化與未標準化兩張葉綠素圖互比。
figures.trap_en: Taking the brackets as evidence that ACC deaminase helped; they only show other groups differ from the unstressed untreated plate.
figures.trap_zh: 把這些括號當成 ACC deaminase 有效的證據；它們只顯示其他組和未逆境未處理那盤不同。

figures.ask_en: Why does this vehicle-only figure sit on a BoPep4 part page?
figures.ask_zh: 為什麼這張純載體的圖會放在 BoPep4 的 part 頁上？
figures.a_en: The vehicle on its own: TB medium carrying WB800 with no protectant, at 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 and 0, at pH 5.7 and pH 7.1. Undiluted vehicle drops fresh weight to about 0.006 g against 0.065 g with no medium at all, and even 1/16 stays below the no-medium group. Chlorophyll per plant follows the same order. Relative chlorophyll reverses it, with the 1/2 dilutions topping that panel near 3.3 and 3.5.
figures.a_zh: 這是單獨測載體：帶 WB800 但不含保護蛋白的 TB 培養液，稀釋為 1、1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16 與 0，並分 pH 5.7 與 pH 7.1。未稀釋的載體把鮮重壓到約 0.006 g，而完全不加培養液是約 0.065 g；就算 1/16 也仍低於不加培養液那組。每株葉綠素的順序相同。相對葉綠素則倒過來，1/2 那兩組衝到約 3.3 與 3.5 的最高點。
figures.q_en: Why is every protectant run read against a 1/40 WB800 control rather than medium alone?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼每次保護蛋白試驗都要對 1/40 WB800 來讀，而不是只對培養基？
opt_en: Because the vehicle is not inert: undiluted it drops fresh weight from about 0.065 g to about 0.006 g, so medium alone is the wrong baseline.
Because 0.1x MS medium cannot be made at those dilutions.
Because WB800 supernatant already contains the protectant at a known concentration.
Because pH 5.7 and pH 7.1 give different results, so a second control is needed.
opt_zh: 因為載體不是惰性的：未稀釋時把鮮重從約 0.065 g 壓到約 0.006 g，所以單用培養基當基準是錯的。
因為 0.1x MS 培養基沒辦法配到那些稀釋度。
因為 WB800 上清液本來就含有已知濃度的保護蛋白。
因為 pH 5.7 和 pH 7.1 結果不同，所以需要第二個對照。
figures.trap_en: Reading the relative chlorophyll panel as a benefit of the vehicle; the ratio climbs because the fresh weight in its denominator has collapsed.
figures.trap_zh: 把相對葉綠素那張讀成載體有好處；比值變高是因為分母的鮮重垮掉了。

figures.ask_en: What does 15-23 keep and what does it give up?
figures.ask_zh: 15–23 保住了什麼、又放棄了什麼？
figures.a_en: Panel (a) plots total contact occupancy for each BoPep4 residue on the 30 ns wild-type run, residues 1-14 lost in red and 15-23 retained in teal; Asn23 is the tallest bar near 5.9, and His14, just outside the fragment, is about 4.2. Panel (b) is the ledger: 49.8 % of contact occupancy retained, 8 of 8 crystallographic contacts kept, 17 receptor partners lost including 5 tyrosines, Asn23-Arg487 kept, Arg9-Asp179 and Lys7-Asp129 lost.
figures.a_zh: (a) 圖畫出 30 ns 野生型軌跡中每個 BoPep4 殘基的總接觸佔有率，紅色是 15–23 丟掉的 1–14 殘基，藍綠色是保留的 15–23；Asn23 是最高的一根，約 5.9，而剛好落在片段外的 His14 約 4.2。(b) 是帳本：接觸佔有率保留 49.8 %，8 個晶體接觸全數保留，失去 17 個受體夥伴（其中 5 個酪胺酸），Asn23–Arg487 保住，Arg9–Asp179 與 Lys7–Asp129 丟失。
figures.q_en: 15-23 keeps all eight crystallographic contacts. Why is that not reassuring?
figures.q_zh: 15–23 保住了全部八個晶體接觸，為什麼這並不讓人放心？
opt_en: The checklist contacts survive while half the occupancy and two near-permanent salt bridges do not, so the checklist is not tracking the whole interface.
Because the eight contacts were measured on a different receptor from the one simulated.
Because all eight contacts lie inside residues 1-14 and were therefore lost.
Because contact occupancy below 50 % is conventionally ignored.
opt_zh: 清單上的接觸都留著，但一半的佔有率和兩條近乎恆存的鹽橋沒了，可見這份清單追蹤的不是整個界面。
因為那八個接觸是在另一個受體上量的，不是模擬的這個。
因為那八個接觸全都位在 1–14 殘基裡，所以都丟失了。
因為低於 50 % 的接觸佔有率照慣例可以忽略。
figures.trap_en: Treating 'all eight contacts kept' as binding preserved; 17 receptor partners and half the contact occupancy are gone.
figures.trap_zh: 把「八個接觸全留」當成結合沒變；17 個受體夥伴和一半的接觸佔有率已經不見了。

figures.ask_en: Do these ACC deaminase panels agree with each other?
figures.ask_zh: 這些 ACC deaminase 的圖彼此一致嗎？
figures.a_en: Three panels, twelve groups, one bar per group, three seedlings, no error bars. On chlorophyll per plant every heated ACC deaminase dilution sits above both heated controls, about 2.6 to 3.0 ug against 2.0 for the 1/40 WB800 vehicle and 1.75 for 0.1x MS medium. On fresh weight the heated bars are flat and do not line up: 1/40 ACC deaminase is about 0.014 g, below the vehicle at about 0.018 g.
figures.a_zh: 三張圖、12 組，每組一根柱、三株苗，沒有誤差棒。每株葉綠素上，加熱後每一個 ACC deaminase 稀釋度都高於兩個加熱對照，約 2.6 到 3.0 µg，而 1/40 WB800 載體約 2.0、0.1x MS 培養基約 1.75。鮮重上加熱各組都很平，而且對不上：1/40 ACC deaminase 約 0.014 g，低於載體的約 0.018 g。
figures.q_en: Chlorophyll favours ACC deaminase and fresh weight does not. How does the page handle that?
figures.q_zh: 葉綠素偏向 ACC deaminase，鮮重卻不支持，頁面怎麼處理？
opt_en: It says so: the captions state that the two readouts point opposite ways rather than quoting the chlorophyll panel alone.
It removes the fresh-weight panel from the figure.
It normalises fresh weight away by plotting only ratios.
It treats fresh weight as the primary endpoint and reports no effect at all.
opt_zh: 直說：圖說明寫出兩種讀數指向相反，而不是只引用葉綠素那一張。
把鮮重那張從圖裡拿掉。
只畫比值，把鮮重標準化掉。
把鮮重當成主要指標，然後報告完全沒有效果。
figures.trap_en: Quoting the chlorophyll gain alone; with one bar per group and no repeat, a 1 ug gap is not a result on its own.
figures.trap_zh: 只引用葉綠素的增幅；每組一根柱又沒有重複，1 µg 的差距本身構不成結果。

figures.ask_en: Why was 15-23 picked off this docking ladder?
figures.ask_zh: 為什麼從這張對接階梯上挑出 15–23？
figures.a_en: Every N-terminal truncation from 1-23 to 17-23 docked twice: AlphaFold3 ipTM in green on the left axis, HADDOCK score in grey on the right. HADDOCK worsens steadily, from -197.8 for the wild type to -97.8 at 15-23, which is circled in red. ipTM stays between 0.86 and 0.94 down to 13-23, drops to 0.54 at 14-23, then reads 0.63, 0.62 and 0.73. Shading marks where AtPep1 equivalents stop being active in the literature.
figures.a_zh: 從 1–23 到 17–23 的每一個 N 端截短都做了兩種對接：綠色是左軸的 AlphaFold3 ipTM，灰色是右軸的 HADDOCK 分數。HADDOCK 一路變差，從野生型的 -197.8 到 15–23 的 -97.8，15–23 被紅圈標出。ipTM 一直到 13–23 都維持在 0.86 到 0.94，在 14–23 掉到 0.54，之後分別是 0.63、0.62、0.73。背景色標出文獻中 AtPep1 對應片段失去活性的位置。
figures.q_en: ipTM for 17-23 is about 0.73, higher than 15-23 at 0.63. What follows from that?
figures.q_zh: 17–23 的 ipTM 約 0.73，高於 15–23 的 0.63。這能推出什麼？
opt_en: The ipTM curve is not monotonic in truncation length, so a single ipTM value cannot rank these fragments by activity.
17-23 is the better peptide and should have been ordered instead of 15-23.
15-23 was mis-docked and that run should be repeated.
ipTM and HADDOCK agree here, so both confirm 17-23 is active.
opt_zh: ipTM 隨截短長度並非單調變化，所以單一個 ipTM 值無法依活性排序這些片段。
17–23 是比較好的胜肽，當初應該訂它而不是 15–23。
15–23 對接出錯，那一次應該重跑。
這裡 ipTM 和 HADDOCK 一致，兩者都確認 17–23 有活性。
figures.trap_en: Reading the ladder as a dose-response in peptide length; the two docking scores disagree in shape and neither was tested in a plant.
figures.trap_zh: 把這張階梯讀成胜肽長度的劑量反應；兩種對接分數的形狀彼此不合，而且都沒有在植物上測過。

figures.ask_en: Can you rank the dilutions from this salinity rack photograph?
figures.ask_zh: 光看這張鹽逆境盤架照片，你能把稀釋度排序嗎？
figures.a_en: The salinity rack with 15-day-old Arabidopsis: the upper block at 0 mM NaCl, the lower block at 100 mM. Within each block BoPep4 runs at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100, with a 1/40 WB800 vehicle and a 0.1x MS medium control, three seedlings per bracket. The salt block is visibly smaller, with purple-red and bleached leaves across all groups including 1/40. One rack, one photograph, no scoring, no repeat.
figures.a_zh: 這是鹽逆境盤架，裡面是 15 天大的阿拉伯芥：上半區 0 mM NaCl，下半區 100 mM。每一區裡 BoPep4 有 1/40、1/60、1/80、1/100，加上 1/40 WB800 載體與 0.1x MS 培養基對照，每括號三株。加鹽那一區明顯較小，所有組（含 1/40）都有紫紅與白化的葉片。只有一盤、一張照片，沒有評分、沒有重複。
figures.q_en: A judge asks you to rank the four dilutions from this image. What is the right answer?
figures.q_zh: 評審要你從這張影像把四個稀釋度排序，正確的回答是什麼？
opt_en: You cannot: three seedlings per bracket in one rack, no scoring and no repeat, so the ordering has to come from the measured panels.
You can: 1/40 is clearly the largest in both blocks.
You can, by counting leaves per plug, which is a validated proxy for biomass.
You cannot, because this photograph was taken before the salt was applied.
opt_zh: 不能：一盤裡每括號只有三株，沒有評分也沒有重複，排序必須回到有量測的圖去看。
可以：1/40 在兩個區塊裡都明顯最大。
可以，數每個孔的葉片數就行，那是經過驗證的生物量替代指標。
不能，因為這張照片是在加鹽之前拍的。
figures.trap_en: Reading leaf colour across the rack as a dose effect; position and plug-to-plug variation are not controlled in a single rack.
figures.trap_zh: 把整盤的葉色差異讀成劑量效應；單一盤架裡並沒有控制位置與孔間變異。

figures.ask_en: Which trace is the negative control, and how does it behave?
figures.ask_zh: 哪一條是陰性對照，它的表現如何？
figures.a_en: Four systems over 30 ns, 1,500 frames, smoothed over 500 ps. In (a) the teal 15-23 trace is the one that travels furthest, touching about 3.5 A above the 3.0 A gate around 14 to 18 ns, though its 2.10 A mean passes. In (c) 15-23 holds the Asn23-Arg487 distance flat near 2.8 A for the whole run, flatter than the wild type, and in (d) its clamp never leaves 4 of 4. Only 9-23 misbehaves.
figures.a_zh: 四個系統各跑 30 ns、1,500 frames，用 500 ps 平滑。(a) 中藍綠色的 15–23 跑得最遠，在 14 到 18 ns 間觸到約 3.5 Å、越過 3.0 Å 門檻，但它的平均值 2.10 Å 仍通過。(c) 中 15–23 把 Asn23–Arg487 距離整段壓在約 2.8 Å，比野生型還平；(d) 中它的夾持從未離開 4/4。只有 9–23 不守規矩。
figures.q_en: The negative control is the steadiest trace on the salt-bridge panel. What does that tell you?
figures.q_zh: 陰性對照在鹽橋那張圖上是最平穩的曲線，這告訴你什麼？
opt_en: That the salt bridge survives the truncation, so it cannot distinguish a fragment missing half its interface from the full peptide.
That 15-23 binds the receptor more tightly than the wild type does.
That the wild-type run was too short to equilibrate properly.
That the salt bridge is an artefact of the force field and should be ignored.
opt_zh: 鹽橋在截短後仍然存在，所以它分辨不出少了一半界面的片段和完整胜肽。
15–23 和受體的結合比野生型更緊。
野生型那一次跑太短，沒有平衡好。
鹽橋是力場造成的假象，應該忽略。
figures.trap_en: Taking steadiness for affinity; a stable contact over 30 ns is not a binding constant, and no binding assay was run.
figures.trap_zh: 把穩定當成親和力；30 ns 內接觸穩定不是結合常數，而且根本沒做結合試驗。

figures.ask_en: How many plates here are marked contaminated, and which ones?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡有幾盤被標為污染，是哪幾盤？
figures.a_en: Eight vertical agar plates on day 15: the top row held at 22 °C, the bottom row thermo-primed at 37 °C, columns untreated, pre-, co- and post-treatment. Nine to ten seedlings per plate and one plate per condition, so the plate is the replicate. Three carry a printed *contaminated mark: co-treatment at 22 °C, and under heat both the co-treatment plate and the untreated control. Heated seedlings are white or pale yellow with much shorter roots.
figures.a_zh: 第 15 天的八盤垂直洋菜板：上排整段維持 22 °C，下排在 37 °C 熱馴化，欄位由左至右為未加、前處理、同處理、後處理。每盤 9 到 10 株，每個條件只有一盤，所以盤本身就是重複單位。其中三盤印有 *contaminated 標記：22 °C 的同處理，以及加熱組的同處理與未處理對照。加熱的苗是白色或淡黃，根也短得多。
figures.q_en: Of the three contaminated plates, which one costs the argument most?
figures.q_zh: 三盤污染裡，哪一盤對論證傷害最大？
opt_en: The heat-stressed untreated control, because it is the plate any treatment has to beat.
The 22 °C co-treatment plate, because it sets the unstressed baseline.
The heat-stressed co-treatment plate, because co-treatment is the lead timing.
None of them, because contamination was corrected for in the analysis.
opt_zh: 加熱的未處理對照，因為任何處理都必須勝過的就是那一盤。
22 °C 的同處理盤，因為它決定了未逆境的基線。
加熱的同處理盤，因為同處理是主打的施用時機。
都不嚴重，因為分析時已經校正了污染。
figures.trap_en: Comparing a treated heat plate against the heat control without noticing that control is one of the three marked contaminated.
figures.trap_zh: 拿處理過的加熱盤去比熱逆境對照，卻沒注意到那個對照正是三盤被標污染的其中之一。

figures.ask_en: What floor does this vehicle series set for the ACC deaminase runs?
figures.ask_zh: 這組載體系列為 ACC deaminase 的試驗定下了什麼底線？
figures.a_en: The same vehicle-only series repeated on the ACC deaminase page: TB medium carrying WB800 with no protectant at 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 and 0, at pH 5.7 and pH 7.1. Fresh weight climbs with dilution at both pH values, from about 0.006 g undiluted to 0.065 g with no medium at pH 5.7, and 0.004 to 0.057 g at pH 7.1. The dose response on this figure belongs to the medium, not to any protectant.
figures.a_zh: 同一組純載體系列也出現在 ACC deaminase 頁：帶 WB800 但不含保護蛋白的 TB 培養液，稀釋為 1、1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16 與 0，分 pH 5.7 與 pH 7.1。兩個 pH 下鮮重都隨稀釋上升，pH 5.7 由未稀釋的約 0.006 g 升到不加培養液的約 0.065 g，pH 7.1 則是 0.004 升到 0.057 g。這張圖上的劑量反應屬於培養液本身，不屬於任何保護蛋白。
figures.q_en: What does this figure establish for the ACC deaminase trials?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖為 ACC deaminase 的試驗確立了什麼？
opt_en: The toxicity of the carrier itself, which is why the protectant runs compare against a matched 1/40 WB800 vehicle.
The optimum pH for ACC deaminase activity, which the enzyme literature puts at 8.0.
The detection limit of the chlorophyll assay at low biomass.
The dilution at which ACC deaminase stops being active.
opt_zh: 載體本身的毒性，這也正是保護蛋白試驗要對上配對的 1/40 WB800 載體的原因。
ACC deaminase 活性的最適 pH，酵素文獻定在 8.0。
低生物量下葉綠素測定的偵測極限。
ACC deaminase 失去活性的稀釋度。
figures.trap_en: Reading 1/16 as harmless; it still sits well below the no-medium group at both pH values.
figures.trap_zh: 把 1/16 當成無害；在兩個 pH 下它仍遠低於完全不加培養液那組。
